case: bounded enum_range result and rebind with a same-named shadow enum in search_path
contract: A custom enum and a different enum with the same type name exist in target and shadow schemas, with the shadow schema first in search_path.
Two-argument enum_range includes non-NULL endpoints; either NULL endpoint is unbounded, both NULL endpoints return the full declared range, and reversed bounds return an empty array.
A literal enum label named NULL remains distinct from SQL NULL; the cases also include empty text and Unicode labels.
Native pg_typeof, array_to_json, array_send and array_dims provide independent type, value, wire-byte and shape oracles.
Rebinding every returned array through its typed text cast reproduces PostgreSQL array_send bytes.

validation.clippy: rtk cargo clippy --offline --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings passed

remaining: Other PostgreSQL enum functions, value consumers, and search_path/session combinations remain open; this focused contract does not close B3.
